shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, screens, clothes, bags, machines, vehicles or license plates.
shared_prompts.photo_numeral: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, and no number anywhere except the one large numeral described: no other signs, buttons, plaques, door numbers or license plates show any digit.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the person and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.nobody: There are no people anywhere in the photo, not even far in the background or inside the vehicles.
shared_prompts.face: The person's face is fully visible in three-quarter view, looking at what they are doing, not at the camera.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
